programmes.t: Angry Planet S2 - "Hurricanes '07"
programmes.d: We hope Season Two will give us the opportunity to make the quintessential Angry Planet show – a full episode exploring a major hurricane that makes landfall in Florida or the Carolinas.

programmes.t: Angry Planet S2 - "B.C. Caving"
programmes.d: In the porous limestone of Canada’s West Coast, great forces are at work under the ground, building and eroding the underground into fantastic shapes. In this episode we’ll witness George’s explorations of these massive underground cave systems.

programmes.t: Angry Planet S2 - "Hot and Cold Crystals"
programmes.d: Miners in Chihauhau, Mexico, has just discovered an amazing sight. The Mexican authorities are only opening up the cavern to scientists and film crews – “Angry Planet” plans to be one of the first in!

programmes.t: The Flying Kestrel S1 - "Stripped"
programmes.d: Meet Nigel McNally and the team from Kestrel Beer who has hopes of breaking the land speed record in a restored 1930’a Riley Kestrel 9.

programmes.t: The Flying Kestrel S1 - "Dyno Test"
programmes.d: The record attempt is only one week away and everything seems to be on track, until the results of a dyno test put a spanner in the works.

programmes.t: The Flying Kestrel S1 - "Meet the Press"
programmes.d: The official press launch of The Flying Kestrel at legendary racetrack, Santa Pod. The Kestrel team is joined by Victor Riley of Riley Cars, and celebrity Rachel Riley.

programmes.t: The Flying Kestrel S1 - "Record Day - Part 1"
programmes.d: The transformation is complete and it’s time for The Flying Kestrel to be put to the test.

programmes.t: Breakthrough S1 - "Extreme Wildfire Combat"
programmes.d: After record-setting conflagrations erupted in the region's prized forests, new tools using cutting-edge technology are being developed to help save property and lives.

programmes.t: Breakthrough S1 - "Saber-Tooth Brawl"
programmes.d: Long ago, Saber-tooth cats ruled over the Americas. Fossil evidence is shinning new light on the violent lives of these mysterious species.

programmes.t: Breakthrough S1 - "Climate Crisis"
programmes.d: The real impact of global warming is now being felt in communities around the world. Climate scientists explain what to expect where you live, and what steps might still be taken to reverse the climate crises.

programmes.t: Breakthrough S1 - "Space Junk Dangers"
programmes.d: A ballistic missile test by India recently shot down one of its own communications satellites. With over 900,000 pieces of debris currently orbiting planet Earth, space trash has become a very real threat to ongoing missions.

programmes.t: More Curious? S1 - "What are the many functions of our Nose?"
programmes.d: Bass describes musical instruments with a low or deep frequency, passports are essential for global travel and what are the many functions of our Nose? Other topics covered include Blood pressure, Cinema, Pop and Comics.

programmes.t: More Curious? S1 - "What are blades?"
programmes.d: What is asphalt and how is it used? What are blades? Discover dishwashers and Irons and explore Greek mythology. Plus many more questions answered in this episode of More Curious.

programmes.t: More Curious? S1 - "From Blenders to Boomerangs"
programmes.d: From blenders to boomerangs, air fryers to mummies, learn about the in’s and out’s of these items and topics plus an in depth look at e - sports covered in this episode.

programmes.t: More Curious? S1 - "What are acoustics?"
programmes.d: This episode answers the big questions. What are acoustics? How can you learn to code? What are fiber optics, and how effective are herbal medicines? Plus much more!

programmes.t: Bright Now S1 - "Tastes Like T-Rex"
programmes.d: Modern birds are the most direct descendants of some of the most iconic dinosaurs to ever walk on this planet. Bue can science really enable us to alter chicken embryos to resemble their mightiest ancestor: T-Rex?

programmes.t: Sumatra's Last Tigers
programmes.d: With Sumatran tigers near extinction, their habitat in decline and humans on the menu, this film shows two top predators living on the same piece of land. The tigers that are being pushed to the brink and the humans risking everything to save them.

programmes.t: Blue World S2 - "Mantas, Tropical Fish Rescue and Tiger Sharks"
programmes.d: Blue World travels to Micronesia to learn about Manta rays, helps rescue tropical fish in New England, and dives with Tiger sharks in the Bahamas.

programmes.t: Blue World S2 - "Sea Turtles, Mangroves and Wolffish"
programmes.d: Blue World heads to Malaysia to learn about sea turtles, explore mangroves, and investigate the Wolffish.

programmes.t: Blue World S2 - "Diving the Mexican Underground and Venomous Fish"
programmes.d: Blue World goes to Mexico to investigate cenotes, study the world’s most venomous fish, and searches for Greenland sharks in Canada’s Gulf of St. Lawrence.

programmes.t: Orphans of the Wild S1 - "Painted Pubs"
programmes.d: Fourteen higly endangered Wild Dog pups arrive at Naankuse, Marlice, with the help of Zacheo meets this challenge head-on - in the meantime the leopard cubs are beginning to pose a danger to Zacheo.

programmes.t: Orphans of the Wild S1 - "Baby Baboons"
programmes.d: When Shona, the injured baby baboon orphan, is introduced to her new friends, things don’t go all that smoothly.

programmes.t: Orphans of the Wild S1 - "Signs in the Sand"
programmes.d: In trying to find a leopard in the vast desert landscape of southern Namibia, Marlice relies on the skills of Kiewiet - an expert Bushman tracker.

programmes.t: Orphans of the Wild S1 - "Cat Trouble"
programmes.d: Establishing the hiararchy within a troop of adult baboons is serious business but when a wild leopard gets trapped the adrenalin really starts pumping.

programmes.t: Animal Ambulance S1 - "Big Dogs and Tiny Troubles"
programmes.d: Drivers Sonia and Angela rescue a giant dog with a puzzling problem, while vets Cristina and Lawrence treat a sad guinea pig and an orphan kitten.

programmes.t: Animal Ambulance S1 - "The Cat, the Hound and the Snake"
programmes.d: A chubby cat, a snake, a greyhound in surgery, and playful kittens keep the team busy in another day of unique and heartwarming animal care.

programmes.t: Secret Life Of The Circler
programmes.d: The journey of the rare and beautiful raptor, the black harrier, from egg to fledging and role of the female while nesting, a time when the mother and her chicks are at their most vulnerable to predators.

programmes.t: Asia's Deadliest Snakes
programmes.d: Snakes are one of the most feared creatures on the planet and Asia is a hotspot for bites! But which is the deadliest? And should we be truly afraid?

programmes.t: Shark Divers
programmes.d: Discover one of the most dangerous jobs in the world...shark diving!

programmes.t: The Aviators S2 - "Aviation 101"
programmes.d: An explanation of some of the very basics of aviation.

programmes.t: The Aviators S2 - "ATC gibberish"
programmes.d: Breaking down and simplifying all that complex sounding radio chatter. Sara learns how to escape from a submerged aircraft and take to the air with a team of formation pilots flying WW2 era planes.

programmes.t: The Aviators S2 - "Can a kid land an airliner?"
programmes.d: A follow up to some of the popular sim segments from season one, but this time with a 12 year old at the controls! Kurtis shows us the many important functions of an often overlooked aspect of Air Traffic Control services and Anthony and Raeleen dig in at Greenville, SC.

programmes.t: The Aviators S2 - "Private pilot emergency"
programmes.d: Anthony closes the season 2 sim segments by having everything but the kitchen sink thrown at him. Can he do it? Spend the day at MCAS Miramar (formerly Top Gun), with US Marine fighter pilots at their legendary base.

programmes.t: The Aviators S2 - "Day in the life of an air show (Part 1)"
programmes.d: We take you behind the scenes for an exclusive look at the inner workings of one of America’s biggest air shows.

programmes.t: The Aviators S2 - "Day in the life of an air show (Part 2 )"
programmes.d: The exciting conclusion to the two-part special including an up-close look at the U.S. Navy Blue Angels.

programmes.t: The Aviators S2 - "AOPA Summit"
programmes.d: The annual event of the Aircraft Owners and Pilots Association. We take you inside the aerial unit of the Los Angeles Police Department to see how the world’s largest police fleet helps to catch bad guys and Jeff talks to Red Bull Air Racer Pete McLeod, about life as a high-adrenalin, competitive fl

programmes.t: Health Explored S1 - "The Purpose of Life Part 2"
programmes.d: Have you ever hiked using your ears, nose and tongue? We learn about the ancient practice of Shin Rin Yoku or Forest Bathing on the outskirts of the worlds largest city.

programmes.t: Health Explored S1 - "Planting a Seed"
programmes.d: With the guidance of a local soil scientist, follow Mike's hands-on journey into the art and science of farming sustainably.

programmes.t: Health Explored S1 - "Pushing our Limits"
programmes.d: Uncover the multifaceted impact of stress on our well-being, and gain fascinating insights into how various stressors impact our physiological responses.

programmes.t: Health Explored S2 - "Open Air Life Part 1"
programmes.d: Travel to Tromso to learn about the concept of "Open Air Life" from the inhabitants of this arctic region.

programmes.t: Health Explored S2 - "Open Air Life Part 2"
programmes.d: Go sea to summit with a skiing experience, as we trek to an unskiied peak, then go diving in the frozen ocean.

programmes.t: Hollywood Weapons: Fact or Fiction? S2 - "Terry's Reindeer Game"
programmes.d: Terry and Larry test a scene from Reindeer Games when Ben Affleck and Charlize Theron get trapped under a frozen lake, and they escape by shooting 3 shots with a 12-gauge shot gun underwater to blast a hole in the ice to escape.

programmes.t: Hollywood Weapons: Fact or Fiction? S2 - "Ex-Men The Origins of Terry"
programmes.d: Terry and Larry test a famous scene from X-men. They are attempting to see if you can split a bullet with a Katana sword

programmes.t: Hollywood Weapons: Fact or Fiction? S2 - "Pay Terry Back"
programmes.d: Terry and Larry test 2 scenes from Mel Gibson’s film Payback. Mel's character is in the back of a taxi when 4 bad guys pull up next to him in an SUV, they open fire and Mel uses a bad guy in the cab as a shield.

programmes.t: Hollywood Weapons: Fact or Fiction? S2 - "Paint Your Red River Stagecoach at High Noon"
programmes.d: Terry and Larry will test different famous shots from westerns. Can you shoot a cowboy hat off the bad guy? Will a shotgun blast really throw you back through a window? Can a single shot from a colt revolver break shackles?

programmes.t: Building to the Sky S1 - "Made in America 1885 - 1930"
programmes.d: Emerging from Chicago and New York, early tall buildings like the Chrysler and Empire State set the foundation for the architectural race to the sky.
